findings.text:
AWS service: S3
Title: S3 bucket allows public access
Description: The bucket policy and block-public-access settings allow anonymous internet access to stored objects.
Severity: critical
CIS control: 2.1.5
NIST control: AC-3
Remediation: Enable S3 Block Public Access, remove public bucket policies, and restrict the bucket to approved principals.

AWS service: IAM
Title: IAM policy grants wildcard administrator permissions
Description: An identity policy permits Action star and Resource star, allowing excessive administrative access.
Severity: high
CIS control: 1.16
NIST control: AC-6
Remediation: Replace wildcard permissions with least-privilege actions and resources, then review attached users and roles.

AWS service: EC2
Title: Security group permits unrestricted SSH access
Description: Inbound TCP port 22 is open to 0.0.0.0/0 and allows any internet host to attempt SSH.
Severity: high
CIS control: 5.2
NIST control: SC-7
Remediation: Limit SSH port 22 to approved administrative CIDR ranges or use Systems Manager Session Manager.

AWS service: EC2
Title: Security group permits unrestricted RDP access
Description: Inbound TCP port 3389 is open to 0.0.0.0/0.
Severity: high
CIS control: 5.2
NIST control: SC-7
Remediation: Restrict RDP to approved VPN or administrator network ranges.

AWS service: IAM
Title: IAM user has stale access keys
Description: Access keys have not been rotated within the required interval.
Severity: medium
CIS control: 1.14
NIST control: IA-5
Remediation: Disable unused access keys, rotate active keys, and prefer temporary role credentials.

AWS service: S3
Title: S3 bucket default encryption is disabled
Description: New S3 objects can be written without server-side encryption.
Severity: medium
CIS control: 2.1.1
NIST control: SC-28
Remediation: Enable default SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS encryption for the bucket.

AWS service: CloudTrail
Title: CloudTrail logging is disabled
Description: Management events are not recorded for the account.
Severity: high
CIS control: 3.1
NIST control: AU-2
Remediation: Enable a multi-region CloudTrail trail and deliver logs to a protected bucket.

AWS service: KMS
Title: KMS customer managed key rotation is disabled
Description: A customer managed encryption key does not rotate key material automatically.
Severity: low
CIS control: 3.8
NIST control: SC-12
Remediation: Enable automatic rotation for the customer managed KMS key.
